mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_ledger (id, tenant_id, hotel_id, room_id, stay_date, effect_kind, operation_id, delta, reason_code, effective_from_date, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{hotelId}, #{roomId}, #{stayDate}, #{effectKind}, #{operationId}, #{delta}, #{reasonCode}, #{effectiveFromDate}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM inventory_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hotel_id = #{hotelId} AND room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY stay_date, effect_kind, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (id, tenant_id, hotel_id, action, actor_type, actor_id, target_type, target_id, before_version, after_version, change_summary, occurred_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{hotelId}, #{action}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{beforeVersion}, #{afterVersion}, #{changeSummary}::jsonb, #{occurredAt}, #{createdAt})
